snippet.title: SAINTS ROW – Boss Factory Trailer
snippet.description:
The time has come for you to #BeYourOwnBoss

Create the best Boss in history – your Boss. The biggest, boldest and best customization tool in Saints Row history is available to download now. Get your Boss Santo Ileso ready by making them ahead of time so you can get on with more important things when the game releases on August 23, like taking over the city, stealing cars and causing general mayhem. We know your time is precious, so we will take those wondrous hours of tweaking chins, eyes, outfit and hair right now so you can get down to business when you get your hands on Saints Row. 

Saints Row Boss Factory is free to download on Xbox One and Xbox Series X|S now.
